claim: BODACC B notices of 2026-04-21 (B202600768283 Foot Locker France SAS, SIREN 382401867; B202600768281 FL France Holdings SAS, SIREN 480023324): by sole-shareholder decision of 13 Apr 2026, Matthew Campbell Barnes (Warwickshire, UK) and Erik Jan Amperse (Dordrecht, NL, b. 1966-09) were appointed Directeurs generaux of both French FL entities. Prior FL France notice listed Vijay Talwar; he no longer appears. FL France Holdings remains chaired by Foot Locker Europe BV (Utrecht 23067735). A Greffe 'decision de modification ... composition' act was also deposited 11/08/2025, four weeks before the deal closed.
data_point: 2 new DGs at 2 French entities effective 2026-04-13; auditor KPMG S.A unchanged

english_translation: By decisions dated 13 April 2026 the sole shareholder appointed Mr Matthew Campbell Barnes and Mr Erik Jan Amperse (resident in Dordrecht) as Managing Directors of the Company.
verifier_note: Verified via BODACC open-data API (both notices, administration field lists Barnes and Amperse as DG; Holdings president Foot Locker Europe BV), recherche-entreprises RNE dirigeants (updated 2026-10-06), Le Figaro Entreprises annonce legale text (13 avril 2026 decision) and Greffe act list (11/08/2025 composition act). Not in KNOWN_BRIEF/baseline (brief has Barnes only as President FL International).

claim: No collective restructuring agreement (accord de methode, RCC, GEPP, PSE majority accord) by Foot Locker France appears in DILA ACCO data; the latest of its 10 company agreements is the NAO-2023 pay accord signed 26 Sep 2024 (effective 1 Nov 2024), which gave coefficient-140 store staff +EUR 7/month gross (EUR 1,789 to 1,796) and was signed by CAT, CFDT and UNSA. Closures so far handled store-by-store with redeployment.

verifier_note: Accord page fetched: '10 accords de la societe FOOT LOCKER FRANCE', accord dated 26/09/2024, effective 01/11/2024, parties CAT CFDT UNSA, EUR 7 raise and quote verbatim. Absence of a restructuring instrument is only PLAUSIBLE: ACCO lags months, and a PSE can be implemented via a unilateral document homologated by DREETS that would not appear in ACCO. 'CGT did not sign' is inferred from the party list only. Not in baseline.
